Basket: 510300 CSI 300 ETF, 159915 ChiNext ETF, 600066 宇通客车, 600406 国电南瑞, 000895 双汇发展.

### Iterations

| Step | What it does |
|---|---:|
| I0 Buy & hold | equal weight, rebalanced monthly |
| I1 Trend filter | each security held only above its 120-day average, fixed 20% slots |
| I2 Slow trend + market gate | average of 150/200/250-day rules; a stock stays in while it or the CSI 300 is in an uptrend; money is split among what is 'on' (max 34% each) |
| I3 + Volatility target | whole portfolio scaled down when its recent volatility exceeds 20% |
| I4 + Dip overlay (final) | idle cash buys sharp 2-day sell-offs (RSI2 < 5) in 10% slots, sold on the rebound |
| R1 Momentum rotation | hold the 2 securities with the best 120-day return among those in an uptrend, weekly |
| R2 Dip-buying only | RSI2 < 5 entries in 34% slots, no core holding |
| R3 Inverse-volatility weights | slow trend, weights proportional to 1/volatility instead of equal |
| R4 Buy & hold + vol target | no trend rule at all, only the 20% volatility target |
